entries.description: Read guiding-principles.md and lessons-learned.md pre-session; confirmed user direction to start security-dashboard-polish Session 1 despite UAT folder still showing in-progress (it is a single-session UAT-prep spec whose change-log.md was never generated; human UAT results already in the checklist JSON).

PageAuthorizationHandler.HandleRequirementAsync now calls context.Fail() with an AuthorizationFailureReason on every denial path (unregistered-fail-closed, explicit Deny, no-allowed-role, scoped-admin missing session context or organization match). Succeeds paths unchanged.

Replaced app.UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute("/not-found") with a custom app.UseStatusCodePages handler that only re-executes /not-found for genuine 404 responses. 401/403 are no longer swallowed and can now surface the Blazor <NotAuthorized> fragment.

Created Components/Shared/AccessDeniedCard.razor (centered MudCard with lock icon, approved copy "You dont have access to this page. If you need access, please request it from your administrator.", role=alert, aria-live=assertive, Back to dashboard button navigating to /dashboard). Wired Routes.razor <NotAuthorized> to render <AccessDeniedCard />. Updated /access-denied page (AccessDenied.razor) to render the same card while preserving its existing data-testid="access-denied-page" wrapper so existing Playwright/WebGuardrail tests that depend on the redirect path keep passing.

Added AccessDenied_BackofficeUser_SecurityDashboard_ShowsCenteredCardAndAvoidsNotFoundAsync Playwright test. Signs in as BackofficeUser jdoe@acmecoffee.com, navigates to /admin/security, asserts URL does not contain /not-found, and asserts access-denied-card, approved copy, and access-denied-back-button are visible.

Added AccessDeniedCardTests bUnit suite (4 tests): approved copy is rendered, Back-to-dashboard button is rendered, clicking the button calls NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/dashboard"), and wrapper has role=alert + aria-live=assertive.

dotnet build: succeeded with 0 errors, 1 pre-existing CS8604 warning in WebGuardrailTests.cs. dotnet test (non-Playwright): 575 passed, 1 failed. The single failure is the pre-existing WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates (missing docs/workflow-auth-observability.md), identical to UAT session 1 and unrelated to this session. AccessDeniedCardTests: 4/4 passed. No other regressions.
Independent cross-provider verification via opus. See session-reviews/session-1-review-1.md for raw output.
